Ina Bonnette - a story of grace and healing

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Ina Bonnette

Unique Selling Point:
One on one interview with Ina Bonnette relaying how she survived the Modimolle monster

Summary:
This is a first-hand account of Ina Bonnette, the survivor of the Modimolle Monster who made headlines when he and his accomplices kidnapped, brutally attacked, and tortured his then estranged wife, Ina. A woman who was brutalized by her ex-husband and his hirelings. Not only did Ina have to endure the horrors and life-altering consequences of that fateful day, but she also lost her son who was murdered in cold blood by her tormentor. This is her story of survival, grace and healing. In this incredible story Ina sets an example of how one can break free from the demons of their past and live a life of victory, by God’s grace.

Script:


Grace and healing Final script for voice over TX 7th November 2021

Ina Bonnette voice over
I have been through 20 operations, and each time its six weeks off, stuck between four walls. And your thoughts are disturbing. Then I realized each time I wouldn’t be here if the 3rd January didn’t happen. So each time, the hate wants to overpower me, and I just decided Lord I have to make a plan because this hate will eat me up. And I had enough strength to pick up a pen, and put ink to paper

Commentary One
It’s taken Ina Bonnette nine years to tell her story of grace and healing, after her former husband Johan Kotze, staged a brutal attack against her, in one of South Africa’s most notorious acts of gender based violence.

Ina
I was degraded but I am not ashamed. I am blessed as a victim to be able to tell the story, because many victims don’t have that privilege.

Commentary Two
Ina Bonnette grew up in a modest but happy Limpopo home. She married in her early 20’s and had two children – Conrad, and three years later Angelique. But her marriage ended after 15 years and by 2005 she was divorced, and began to rebuild her life here in Modimolle

LINK
Then in 2009 a friend gave her number to Johan Kotze. He was looking to meet someone spontaneous with a love for the outdoors, and Ina seemed like the perfect fit.

Ina
At that stage it was wow! A single mother with two children and here comes a Free State farmer and he was interested. It couldn’t be and he was very charming. And yes the time went by and I did fall in love.

Commentary three
Within 9 months Kotze proposed, and they married in October 2010. But everything changed on the honeymoon night

Ina
During the reception, he kept me close to him. I think at that stage I felt honoured, loved. Today I call it stupidity. When we entered the honeymoon suite, there was suddenly a drastic change in Kotze towards the relationship. He began to lay down the law, I must pick up weight, I must cut my hair the way he wants; I must dress the way he prescribes; my parents must make appointments to visit us at home; my children mustn’t ask me for anything, he must give permission, and every day I must share my diary with him, who I am seeing and where I am meeting them.


Claire
What went through your mind when he is giving you all these rules?
Ina
I just thought what the hell is going on? I spent my honeymoon night crying.

Commentary four
From there, the relationship deteriorated further
Ina
And I really tried to hold out for 5 months, but he literally took away my identity, my
self- worth, my respect- he literally destroyed it, and five months later I walked out

Commentary five
Kotze had moved the family to this house. He called it the love house, and the first time she left him, he convinced her to go back

Ina
Look, Kotze is a master manipulator. Ounooi I am going to change, let’s talk about what bothers you.
Claire
What made you leave for the final time?
Ina
That July he said I must go visit my parents in Warmbaths, and Sunday when I walked into the house there was nothing left inside.
Claire
Nothing?
My clothes were lying on the floor, where portraits were, my underwear hung on the nails
Claire
Your underwear was nailed to the wall?
Ina
Yes he took the portraits down, and the nails that remained, he hung my underwear on those nails.

LINK
For Ina the marriage was over, and she moved here with her daughter completely unaware that he was tracking her every move.

Ina
I thought he had gone back to Bloemfontein. Little did I know that every night he was watching me. As I was sleeping, he would pull the curtains aside and watch me while I lay and slept

Commentary Six
Dr Rhona Van Niekerk is a criminologist and trauma councilor and has helped Ina Bonnette
on her journey of recovery



Rhona
She loves people and she gives herself to people and he was able to use that to control and manipulate that. If you are really connected to yourself. if you have a rule in life, it’s a simple rule and that everything in life needs to be making sense, and it needs to be good for you

Commentary seven
Bonnette had no idea how much danger she was in. Kotze had stayed in Modimolle, moving out of the so called love house and renting this house. On the 3rd of January 2012, he gave her a call and said he was ready to talk about a divorce. So she met him here, at the place Ina now calls the horror house.

Ina
Everything looked in order, I didn’t feel afraid. Nothing. And his words were to me, do you want to sit inside or outside? And I said no there is a table with chairs, let’s sit in the shade.

Commentary eight
He asked if she would give the marriage another chance. Ina said no.

INA
Then he mentions a box of things in the room, and my answer to him, was I left with nothing so keep the box, throw it away! And again this master manipulator emerged
“But just come and look, just make certain”
And so we went into the house

LINK
In this house Kotze had already arranged for three men to be waiting in a darkened room. They would later rape her, but first he would mutilate her most intimate body parts

Ina
I was really like a sheep to the slaughterhouse, tied to the bed. My right arm was tied to the headboard with cable ties my left arm to the windowsill so I was literally spreadeagled. And I just carried on screaming, but it feels like it stalls in your throat

Commentary nine
Then Kotze ordered one of the men to silence her with tape
Ina
So he just wrapped it around my head, leaving this tiny hole with just enough space to breathe. I thought I was going to suffocate

Commentary ten
Kotze then revealed his instruments of torture – wire cutters, a knife, nails. Soon her blood was everywhere.

Ina
I prayed with my eyes open that day, and I said Lord, if it’s your purpose for me to live through this attack, keep my thoughts clear so I can remember, and suddenly it felt like I was lifted out of my body and placed next to it, and I saw everything that happened. But I still experienced the pain, but from a different perspective.

Claire
While you were being raped you saw him watching you?
Ina
His eyes were grey, lifeless, but at the same time he had a smile on his face. I will never forget it.

Commentary eleven
But incredibly the worst was not yet over. Kotze had lured her son Conrad to the house, and he held a gun to her head to keep her quiet

Claire
Were you worried your child will see you in that state?
Ina
Yes that was my greatest fear at that stage, because Kotze had said that when Conrad arrives, he will bring him into the room, and he will force him to have intercourse with me, and if my child can’t do it, then he would kill him on top of me. And I said God please just not that!

Commentary twelve
Then he went out, and she heard three shots in the adjacent room

Ina
And then I heard, “uncle, please don’t!” and the first shot. And then I knew my child was there. What he did to me he could have done it 66 times over, but why my son? Why my son?

Commentary thirteen
Eleven days later Kotze was arrested, and then the three men that raped her. The case was postponed to April 2013, but Ina battled through the court processes, trying to overcome her grief and trauma

Ina
I thought I was talking to God, but I was actually fighting with him. Why? Was Conrad aware that I was in the room next door? Was he aware I was willing to die for him? And then God, take away his cries for help, and put a smile back on my child’s face in my dreams.

Rhona
Every victim has the ability to recover but they have to be warriors, they have to fight it, they have to be disciplined with their thoughts. Inner thoughts that they need reprogramme, and I always tell people it’s not your brain thinking it’s you telling your brain what to think.



Commentary fourteen
Bonnette says she was in a dark hole when the case was postponed, until she had a spiritual experience, where she saw Conrad’s face in the clouds, and took this photo.

And God told me Conrad was aware I was willing to die for him, and he took my child’s pleas, and he changed my child’s pleas into a smiling face. There my life really turned around, where I realized this court case, however difficult, will ensure justice for Conrad’s sake. And it did.

Commentary fifteen
Johan Kotze received two life sentences and 25 years behind bars, while Ina started working with Dr Van Niekerk. She didn’t see a future as just a victim of the Modimolle monster

Dr Rhona Van Niekerk
In Afrikaans its slagoffer and it's like going to be slaughtered. And she was slaughtered. She she will tell you, no, I'm not a victim. I've survived this and I'm there fight it. And I'm there to teach people how to fight this.

Ina
The day of the attack, Kotze put an instrument in my hands, not a physical instrument but that which he repeatedly said to me. That when he is done with a woman, she either dies by suicide or she lands up in an institution. And that was a tool that I used in my mind.

Commentary sixteen
She knew she was neither crazy, nor would she take her own life

Ina
I choose life. It doesn’t matter if you have fallen a thousand times, but if you are prepared to get up a thousand and one times. If you can make that choice, there is hope and if there is hope there is victory, and if there is victory there is healing.

THE END 12 00

PROMO ONE 11 seconds
Ina Bonnette, brutally attacked in one of South Africa’s most notorious cases of gender based violence, has found healing and no longer sees herself as a victim

PROMO TWO 21 seconds
Ina Bonnette survived a heinous attack by her former husband Johan Kotze in Modimolle. Now she recounts her story of grace and healing
Ina
I was degraded but I am not ashamed. I am blessed as a victim to be able to tell the story, because many victims don’t have that privilege

PROMO THREE 21 seconds
Ina
His eyes were grey, lifeless, but at the same time he had a smile on his face. I will never forget it.

Voice over
How do you overcome the trauma of a violent attack by your own husband. The Modimolle monster tried to destroy her life but Ina Bonnette has found healing
